_doc: MEASURED on tiny deterministic toys (stdlib). Reproduces the QUALITATIVE story, not the papers' large-N magnitudes. Generator: _research/gen_l18.py. k=5, n=120 (hubness); n=80, d=10 (anisotropy).

anisotropy._note: random-pair cosine: a narrow cone reads HIGH; centering (subtract the mean) restores ~0; dropping the dominant direction keeps it flat — isotropy recovered.

hubnessNote: kNN occurrence-count skew rises with dimension; hubs correlate with proximity to the centroid.
